name: se
description: Maintain durable project knowledge, improve architecture, capture Ideas, converge Features, and deliver reviewed implementation work.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain knowledge, shape features, and deliver reviewed work.
interface.longDescription: SE provides five separate skills for durable repository knowledge, evidence-backed architecture improvement, Idea capture, Feature Spec convergence, and reviewed implementation delivery. Learn owns Project Context and ADR routing; Improve Codebase Architecture discovers and pressure-tests refactors; Idea, Feature, and Implement share one feature workflow contract while delegating GitHub transport to G.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable project knowledge and ADRs.
Use $se:improve-codebase-architecture to find and pressure-test architecture improvements.
Use $se:feature to turn an Idea into an agent-ready Feature Spec bundle.
